pp-animal-homes.note: Association - animal appears, pick where it sleeps. Decoys are real homes of other animals. horse dropped (stable.jpg rejected).

pp-animal-hunt.note: Kept its existing mechanic (tracing, stacking, hunting, quizzing) and had the illustrated backdrop applied for consistency with the rebuilt set.

pp-animal-quiz.note: Three panels. Audio fixed twice over: pool limited to the 6 animals with a verified file, and a speaker pad makes hearing it a TAP (a timer-fired sound is blocked by autoplay policy).

pp-animal-sort.note: Three panels, one queue each. Binary sort with a per-child tally.

pp-animals.note: Backdrop changed to meadow; cards capped at 240px so nothing clips.

pp-body-parts.note: Reverted to the original. I had only added 3 lines of backdrop, never rebuilt it - that change is undone.

pp-egg-count.note: Egg shape: taller than wide with the wide end down, not a circle.

pp-hen-types.note: Fine discrimination - every card is poultry, so the differences are within a category not between.

pp-mosquito-clap.note: Rebuilt on the Fruit Ninja mechanic: targets launch on an arc with gravity, a SWIPE leaves a trail and kills what the line crosses. Butterflies are the bomb - cost a life, never points. Speed on the toolbar.

pp-odd-one-out.note: Rebuilt as EXCLUSION - three animals share a group, one does not. Alternates which group supplies the stranger so it cannot be won by always picking the wild one. Kuttu says WHY after a correct tap.

pp-size-color.note: Rebuilt as the sorter asked for: big / small / green bins, one object at a time, audio on each. Every object has exactly one true answer by design.

pp-size-quiz.note: Three independent games - each panel deals its own pair and moves on immediately. Same object at two sizes, so it tests perception not knowledge.

pri-flower-match.note: Three panels, own touches each. Fixed 4-column grid instead of wrapping, which is what overflowed before.

pri-flowers.note: Rebuilt as visual search - find EVERY rose among 14 mixed blooms. jamanti and lotus excluded (rejected at asset review), not swapped for emoji.

pri-houses.note: Three panels. No 3D - built on the approved photographs only, since the models were never usable.

pri-rooms.note: Revised on review: rooms moved to the upper half and are TAPPED, not dragged. Fixed the bug that stopped object 2 appearing (burstAt was passed coordinates instead of an element and threw).
